audit.whatIsWrong: The page describes Twisted Advance only as a root that 'cancels your channel', in five places, and never mentions that Maokai is untargetable for the entire dash. It also invents a duration — 'his W root is a 1.5-second leash' — that appears nowhere in the kit.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags untargetable-dodges-burst for exactly this ability. Untargetable is what makes the level-6 exchange lose: a Pop Blossom or a Q spent while he is mid-dash lands on nothing at all, which is a different failure from being interrupted, and the answer is to wait the 14s out rather than to cast faster. Whether a root can cancel Pop Blossom's preparation is not stated in either kit, so I did not keep that claim.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text, wants.foe[2], content.mid, content.late, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now state the untargetable dash, the root on arrival and the 14s / 525 numbers; the invented 1.5s is gone.
sources: kit: Maokai W text and flags, cd 14/13/12/11/10, range 525

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your one breathing room: you out-waveclear him with Q re-blooms and can poke his low-range body while he can't punish farm without committing W. But don't mistake that for winning the all-in. At 6 he reclaims it — his W root cancels your Pop Blossom channel mid-wind-up, and his saplings and minimap presence make it hard to set the ult up unseen. Only ult if you've already landed E and he's burned W; otherwise you channel, get rooted, and trade your whole rotation for nothing while his sustain heals it back.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your one breathing room: you out-waveclear him with Q re-blooms and can poke his low-range body while he can't punish farm without committing W. But don't mistake that for winning the all-in. At 6 he reclaims it — Twisted Advance makes him untargetable for the whole dash and roots you on arrival, so a rotation spent into it lands on nothing. Only commit if you've already landed E and he's burned that 14s; otherwise you get rooted and Sap Magic heals the damage back.

edits.before: Once you hit your first item the lane stops being the point — shove the wave with Q and go make plays mid or bot, because you will never solo-kill a Maokai through his passive sustain and saplings. In teamfights you're the better scaler: a clean Pop Blossom on a clustered backline does what he never can. Just respect that he exists to lock you — the instant you channel anything, his W root is a 1.5-second leash, so ult from fog or behind your frontline, never from his face.
edits.after: Once you hit your first item the lane stops being the point — shove the wave with Q and go make plays mid or bot, because you will never solo-kill a Maokai through Sap Magic's sustain and his saplings. In teamfights you're the better scaler: a clean Pop Blossom on a clustered backline does what he never can. Just respect that he exists to lock you — Twisted Advance is untargetable on the way in and roots on arrival, so ult from fog or behind your frontline, never from his face.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W clone + disguise for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance: matchup-defining — 14s at rank 1 over 525 range; he is untargetable for the dash, so burst spent into it is wasted, and it roots on arrival. - Sap Magic heals his attacks and speeds up whenever a spell hits him.

edits.before: Track Maokai’s Twisted Advance (Root): Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is untargetable for the whole dash and roots on arrival — 14s at rank 1, so wait it out instead of bursting into it.

notes: The untargetable window is the fact this page was missing: burst spent while Maokai is mid-Twisted-Advance is spent on nothing, which is why level 6 feels unwinnable even when the root lands. I removed the '1.5-second leash' figure in two places because no duration appears in the kit file and I could not verify it. I also stopped short of claiming Twisted Advance's root cancels Pop Blossom's preparation — neither kit states whether immobilizing CC interrupts the ult, and Neeko's passive text only says it breaks her disguise.
